column1: # model-roles.tsv: every place a tt-* skill picks a model, in one list.
# Read by scripts/model-config.sh (and so by tt-config). The defaults here are
#   role   kind   tier   used-by   what it does   model   effort
# kind: sub  = a subagent the skill spawns; model and effort are applied.
#       main = a stage that runs in your own session; advisory only, because a
#              skill cannot change the session's model. The role is the skill name.
# tier: 1 = highest value for an expensive model, 4 = lowest.
# model: sonnet | opus | haiku | fable | -    effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max | -
# "-" means "don't set it": the subagent (or the session) keeps its own.
# Add a role here, then name it in the skill with `model-config.sh get <role>`.
